name: bread
description: BREAD — the umbrella for the stack: batch + grain (the grain monorepo now holds grain · mill · proof · crumb) as submodules, plus the project-wide plans board (PANTRY-hosted).
author: Tjakoen Stolk <tjakoen.s@gmail.com> (https://tjakoen.github.io)

scripts.deps:refresh: for p in batch pantry; do bun add -d @tjakoen/$p@github:tjakoen/$p#$(git ls-remote https://github.com/tjakoen/$p.git main | cut -c1-7); done && bun update @tjakoen/grain @tjakoen/mill @tjakoen/proof

//devDependencies: The pins of record for the members. Since the 2026-07-19 grain-monorepo cutover, grain · mill · proof are PUBLISHED packages (GitHub Packages, @tjakoen scope → see .npmrc) pinned to versions, NOT github SHAs; batch + pantry stay github git-deps (neither is published). deps:refresh re-pins batch+pantry by sha and 'bun update's the three published layers. This umbrella stays INTENTIONALLY LOCKLESS (bun.lock gitignored): bun (1.3.14 + 1.2.21) can't resolve the nested github git-dep graph — bread -> pantry -> tjakoen.github.io -> layers — from scratch (see the bread-bun-nested-git blocker; the monorepo killed the INTERNAL grain->mill->proof cascade but bread still nests through pantry + the portfolio git-deps). bread never needs a lock anyway: everything runs via bunx (cockpit -> bunx pantry, plans:check -> bunx proof), which resolve in isolation and don't use bread's own node_modules. Do NOT try to regenerate a lock here. (standards was folded into the portfolio 2026-07-09 and its repo deleted; pantry resolves /standards from the tjakoen.github.io git-dep.)
